name: Anne Richardson
office: Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Two

items.text: Anne Richardson is an associate justice on the California Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Two, serving since November 2024. She served as a Los Angeles County Superior Court judge from 2018 to 2024, handling family law and civil cases. Before that, she directed the litigation of consumer cases at Public Counsel and worked in private practice for 24 years.
